content.content:
We need to create a 5-day trip plan for 2 people from Islip (NY) to Pennsylvania, covering 2 cities (presumably within Pennsylvania). Dates March 19-23 2022. Budget $2700. Need child-friendly accommodation (under 10) and entire rooms. No flights, so likely drive (car rental) or train/bus. We'll need to allocate transportation, meals, attractions, accommodation.

We must "save it" by calling submit_day_plan for each day (5 calls). Must fill fields: day, current_city, transportation, breakfast, attraction, lunch, dinner, accommodation.

We need to decide cities: maybe Philadelphia and Pittsburgh? Those are two major cities. But travel from Islip to Pennsylvania: maybe first city is Philadelphia (approx 3.5h drive), then second city Pittsburgh (approx 5h drive from Philadelphia). That's plausible.

We need to ensure budget: $2700 for 2 people for 5 days. Include car rental, gas, hotels (entire rooms, child-friendly), meals. Rough estimate: Car rental $70/day = $350, gas $100, hotels $150/night x5 = $750, meals $50/day per person = $500, attractions $200, total ~ $2000, within budget.

We need to specify transportation each day: day1 drive from Islip to Philadelphia (rental car). day2 local transport within Philly (maybe parking). day3 drive from Philly to Pittsburgh. day4 local in Pittsburgh. day5 drive back to Islip.

Make sure to include transportation description per day.

Now need to produce plan. For each day:

Day 1 (March 19): Travel from Islip to Philadelphia. Breakfast maybe at home in Islip or on the road. We'll specify breakfast "Home-cooked Breakfast, Islip". Attraction maybe "Independence Hall, Philadelphia; Liberty Bell, Philadelphia". Lunch maybe "Reading Terminal Market, Philadelphia". Dinner maybe "Hard Rock Cafe, Philadelphia". Accommodation: "Family Suite at Holiday Inn Express Philadelphia - Chestnut Hill, Philadelphia". Transportation: "Rental Car: Pickup at Islip, Drive to Philadelphia, 3.5 hrs".

Day 2 (March 20): Full day in Philadelphia. Breakfast at hotel. Attractions: "Philadelphia Zoo, Philadelphia; Please Touch Museum, Philadelphia". Lunch "Bistro at the Zoo". Dinner "Parc, Philadelphia". Transportation "Rental Car parked at hotel".

Day 3 (March 21): Travel to Pittsburgh. Breakfast at hotel. Drive 5 hrs. Attraction maybe "The Andy Warhol Museum, Pittsburgh" after arrival. Lunch maybe "Primanti Bros, Pittsburgh". Dinner "The Old Spaghetti Factory, Pittsburgh". Accommodation "Family Suite at Residence Inn by Marriott Pittsburgh Downtown". Transportation: "Rental Car: Drive from Philadelphia to Pittsburgh, 5 hrs".

Day 4 (March 22): Explore Pittsburgh. Breakfast at hotel. Attractions: "Carnegie Science Center, Pittsburgh; Phipps Conservatory, Pittsburgh". Lunch "Carnegie Science Center Café". Dinner "Mount Oliver Brewing Company, Pittsburgh". Transportation "Rental Car local".

Day 5 (March 23): Return to Islip. Breakfast at hotel. Drive back (approx 7 hrs). Lunch on the road maybe "Stop at a Deli". Dinner at home. Accommodation maybe "Home". Transportation: "Rental Car: Drive from Pittsburgh to Islip, Return Car".

Now call submit_day_plan for each day. Ensure fields filled. Use "-" for fields not applicable. For day 5, accommodation maybe "Home, Islip". Provide all.

Proceed.

attraction.description: Use a ";" to separate different attractions, with each attraction formatted as "Name, City". e.g. "The Charlotte Museum of History, Charlotte;"

accommodation.description: e.g. "Affordable Spacious Refurbished Room in Bushwick!, Charlotte"
